claim: Naples to Sorrento straight-line distance is ~26 km; driving 52 km. Nerano sits south of Sorrento, putting Naples city centre at ~30 km from Nerano as the crow flies.
quote: The distance between Naples and Sorrento is 25.97 km (straight line).

claim: ICSO 2026 — 16th International Conference on Space Optics — is held at Hilton Sorrento Palace, ~10-minute walk from Sorrento centre; co-organised by ESA and CNES.
quote: The Hilton Sorrento Palace Hotel in Sorrento, Italy. … a 10-minute walk from Sorrento's lively town center … 16th edition of the conference, co-organized by ESA and CNES.

claim: ICSO 2026 takes place 12–16 October 2026 in Sorrento.
quote: ICSO 2026 will be held October 12–16, 2026 in Sorrento, Italy.

claim: IEEE MLISE 2026 (6th International Conference on Machine Learning and Intelligent Systems Engineering) runs 28–31 May 2026 at the CESTEV@UNINA building, University of Naples Federico II.
quote: MLISE 2026 will be held in Naples, Italy during May 28-31, 2026. The venue is University of Naples Federico II, within its University Service Center for Life Sciences and Technologies (CESTEV@UNINA).

claim: Security Summit Napoli 2026 ran 28 May 2026 at Città della Scienza (Bagnoli, Naples), free with registration; covered NIS2, DORA, healthcare cyber.
quote: May 28, 2026, starting at 9:30 AM … Città della Scienza (Science City), Naples … Participation is free with registration at securitysummit.it.

claim: EWP Convention 2026 (Erasmus Without Paper) is hosted at University of Naples Federico II, 16–18 June 2026, in the cloister of Santi Marcellino e Festo — digital innovation for academic mobility.
quote: EWP Convention – Erasmus Without Paper 2026 from June 16-18, 2026 … held in the cloister of Santi Marcellino and Festo.

claim: IEEE MNC 2026 (International Symposium on Measurements in Networking and Communications) runs 13–16 July 2026 at the Federico II Conference Center, Naples.
quote: The University of Naples Federico II, centered around its elegant Federico II Conference Center … MNC 2026 will provide a rich forum for researchers and practitioners from industry, academia, government and standardization bodies in the areas of measurement, networking, communications, wireless systems, sensor networks, and IoT. … July 13-16, 2026.

claim: Journées Montoises (20th edition) on theoretical computer science is hosted at University of Naples Federico II, 7–11 September 2026; topics include automata, formal languages, symbolic dynamics, logic.
quote: The 20th edition will take place from September 7 to 11, 2026 at the University of Naples Federico II in Italy.

claim: IEEE ITSC 2026 (29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems) takes place at the Stazione Marittima conference venue, central Naples, 15–18 September 2026.
quote: tour departures … from Stazione Marittima (conference venue)

claim: IEEE eScience 2026 (22nd International eScience Conference) runs 28 September – 2 October 2026 in Naples; covers AI/ML, HPC, FAIR data, scientific workflows.
quote: September 28-October 2, 2026 in Naples, Italy. … Artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science applications; High-performance computing and cloud infrastructure; FAIR principles …

claim: Napoli DevFest 2026 — themed Futuro Liquido — is scheduled for Saturday 17 October 2026 at Città della Scienza, organised by GDG Napoli with Lemon Academy ETS.
quote: Sabato 17 Ottobre … Città della Scienza … organized by Google Developer Groups Napoli in partnership with Lemon Academy ETS.

claim: GDG Napoli (Google Developer Group) has 1,750 members and runs an annual DevFest plus irregular meetups and hackathons. Most recent flagship was DevFest 11 Oct 2025.
quote: 1,750 group members … The most recent DevFest was held on October 11, 2025 … Currently, there are no scheduled upcoming events listed.

claim: DevDay Napoli is a monthly developer meetup (817 members), talks plus networking; venue rotates around Naples.
quote: DevDay Napoli, 817 developers

claim: AWS User Group Napoli (434 members) is largely dormant for in-person events; last regular meetup April 2024. The March 2026 AWS Community GameDay Europe was hosted at VMEngine in Pozzuoli (~33 km from Nerano — outside the radius).
quote: AWS Community GameDay Europe 2026 – Napoli & Salerno on March 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM CET, located at VMEngine in Pozzuoli with 8 registered participants. … The last event was on April 18, 2024 … 434 members.

claim: The 3rd National Congress of the National Quantum Science and Technology Institute (NQSTI) was hosted at Città della Scienza Naples, 14–17 April 2026 — quantum computing, secure communications, deep-tech.
quote: From April 14-17, 2026, Città della Scienza will host the third edition of the National Quantum Science and Technology Institute congress … quantum computing, secure communications, next-generation sensors, innovative materials, and industrial applications and technology transfer.

claim: Centro Congressi Stazione Marittima di Napoli is the largest congress centre in downtown Naples — 3,300 m², 18 multipurpose halls, 700-seat plenary, up to 1,800 seats total.
quote: the largest congress center in downtown Naples, with a total surface of 3,300 m² and 18 multi-purpose halls, plus a plenary hall with 700 seats.

claim: Hilton Sorrento Palace (Via Rivolo Sant'Antonio 13, 80067 Sorrento) — the dominant MICE venue on the Sorrento Peninsula: 24 meeting rooms, 1,500-seat auditorium, 3,500 m² exhibition.
quote: Via Rivolo Sant'Antonio 13, 80067 Sorrento, Italia … 24 versatile meeting rooms plus the Auditorium Sirene with space for up to 1,500 delegates, along with a 37,000 square foot exhibition area

claim: Apple Developer Academy is hosted at the Federico II San Giovanni a Teduccio campus in east Naples; 9-month free programme run with Apple. Public events (Future Fair, talks) appear on their newsroom.
quote: The program takes place at the San Giovanni a Teduccio university campus and is organized by Federico II University in collaboration with Apple.

claim: Skal International held a conference 'How to use AI in tourism and hospitality' at Bosco de' Medici, Pompei, on 23 March 2026 — a rare local IT-adjacent event south of Naples.
quote: Monday, March 23, 2026, at 6 PM at the Bosco de' Medici complex (via Antonio Segni) in Pompeii, Skal International organized a conference titled 'Come usare l'IA nel settore del turismo e dell'ospitalità'

claim: The Big Hack – Special Edition is an annual two-day hackathon at the Apple Developer Academy in Naples, sponsored by Campania Region and the City of Naples; 2025 edition ran 25–26 Oct, an annual cadence is likely for 2026.

claim: Active tech meetup groups in Naples include AWS User Group Napoli (434), PyCampania (167), and others; no Sorrento-Peninsula tech groups appear on Meetup.

claim: GDG Campania (Google Developer Group Campania) is the broader regional GDG covering Naples and Salerno; sister group to GDG Napoli.
